symptom: A Data grid 2 written by `create page` to a blank Mendix 10.24.0 project fails `mx check` with CE0463 "The definition of this widget has changed" until `mxcli fix widgets` runs; the same script on 11.x (and on 10.24.24) is clean. Studio Pro's own template grids in the project do not fail
cause: 10.24.0 ships Data Widgets 2.30.3 and the embedded template is 3.4-shaped, so `AugmentTemplate` rebuilds the definition — and got three things wrong, each a real diff against `mx update-widgets` (the Object was identical): (1) `mpkPropDefsByKey` / `syncDefinitionAttrs` indexed PropertyDefs by BARE key across nesting levels, and 2.30.3 declares `filter` twice (column: widgets; filterList item: attribute), so the column's filter got the item's Type/Caption/AllowedTypes/DataSource/Required; (2) exemplar indices were taken BEFORE stale properties were removed, so the new `filterList` object list was cloned from whatever shifted into the Object exemplar's slot (an Integer) and had no ObjectType — same in the nested pass; (3) the mpk parser never read `<associationTypes>` / `selectableObjects`, so `filterAssociation` had none and `filterAssociationOptionLabelAttr` kept its cloned exemplar's [Reference, ReferenceSet]. A fourth, masked by the grid failing first: template Translations kept where the package ships none (drop-down filter `emptyOptionCaption`)
file: `modelsdk/widgets/augment.go` (`scopedKey`/`walkPropertyTypes` used by all reconcile passes, `topLevelExemplars` after stale removal, nested re-index, AssociationTypes/SelectableObjectsProperty/Translations reconcile), `modelsdk/widgets/mpk/mpk.go` (`AssociationTypes`, `SelectableObjects`)
insight: Reproduce on the EXACT minor the reporter used: 10.24.24 ships a different Data Widgets and showed no grid CE0463 on either v0.26.0 or main, which nearly closed this as not-reproducible. Then the Type diff (flatten keyed by PropertyKey PATH, not index) against `mx update-widgets` on a copy bounded it to ~40 paths in three clusters; patching one cluster at a time showed none alone clears CE0463 — CE0463 compares the whole widget. A failing outer widget MASKS CE0463 in widgets nested in it (the drop-down filters surfaced only after the grids were fixed), so re-measure after every fix. Any augmentation map keyed by bare PropertyKey is suspect: keys repeat across object lists (`filter`, `caption`, `attribute`). Measured: doctype-tests/31 on 10.24.0 7 -> 0 CE0463, on 10.24.24 2 -> 0, on 11.6.6 0 -> 0; doctype-tests/32 on 11.6.6 3 -> 2 (Maps map1 cleared, map2 and Accordion acc2 remain). The sibling `sdk/widgets` copy was not changed: no production code imports it
